name: Stormbringer: Aethermancy raises Invigorating Surge's crit chance natively (#2801)
contract: Aethermancy rank1 (705690) effect0 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE), EffectBasePoints 19 + EffectDieSides 1 = 20, EffectSpellClassMask word1 1073741824 (0x40000000) matching Invigorating Surge's (500038) own SpellFamilyFlags word1 exactly (confirmed today via coa-dbc-viewer against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset). SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (op 7) is read generically at Unit.cpp:9697 via Player::ApplySpellMod; that function's non-CASTING_TIME/DURATION branch computes basevalue*totalmul+totalflat (Player.cpp:10315-10326), so rank1's flat-type mod yields base+20 -- the scenario asserts the actual formula on an arbitrary base of 100 rather than a hand-picked constant. Rank 1 has no module code; it is native SpellInfo/spellmod mechanics. Rank 2 (705691) is deliberately NOT asserted here: its DBC effect0 is aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER for the same op, and Player::ApplySpellMod's PCT branch returns early for SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE unless HasSpellModApplied is already true for the same cast (Player.cpp:10264-10266), which never happens for the direct heal Invigorating Surge, so rank 2 is unreachable natively. Rank 2 is covered by the fix scenario stormbringer-fix-aethermancy.json, which asserts the module contract in AscensionStormbringerContracts.cpp.
